resources.string: Derive dark artwork for eligible static and bitmap-only layered icons while retaining their animation. Dynamic adaptation adds background rendering and cache overhead.

Derived artwork is not an independent upstream dark variant or Monet. Static layers use a dark gradient; flat icons are dimmed. Eligible dynamic groups retain their layers, animation timing and events, with texture selectors and one additional background renderer per group. Complex Lottie, text, procedural artwork and existing author dark behavior remain unchanged. Results are cached. Regenerate and apply after changing this option.
Keep original layers, native animation and existing dark behavior. No additional derived dark artwork is generated.

Derive dark artwork for eligible static icons and a bounded subset of bitmap-only dynamic groups, retaining their animation. Unsupported groups and existing author dark behavior stay unchanged. Dynamic adaptation adds rendering and cache overhead.
Preview shows still images for the current options, not live animation or the last generated or applied pack. Generate and apply again after changing options.
